body:
task:a902c13a6f97d93f moved the task viewer to the side once the window is at least 0.91 times as wide as it is tall. That was too aggressive. Change it to **1.1×**.

Today `watch_side` in the board's `api.mjs` uses `(min-aspect-ratio: 91/100)`. The new value is `11/10`.

## Done when
- `watch_side` uses `(min-aspect-ratio: 11/10)`.
- Text that names 0.91 says 1.1: the comment above `watch_side` in `api.mjs`, the doc comments on `solace_board.Model` (`side`), `solace_board.Msg` (`Sided`) and `solace_board.watch_side`, the doc comment on `solace_board_test.a_wide_window_puts_the_band_on_the_side_test`, and the board README.
- The board's and the frontend's bundled `app.js` are rebuilt.
title: board: side band at 1.1× width
